body.name: PsiTG
body.def: \(\Psi_{T,G}(p_T)\) declares every directed and formal source incidence by the signs \(Z_e(T,p_T)>0\) and \(Z_e(T,p_T)=0\), normalizes every source with no positive incidence to an ignored simplex-vertex source, replaces each remaining formal source label \(C\) by its realized nonempty child set \(D_C=\{j\in C:Z_{\operatorname{src}(C,j)}(T,p_T)>0\}\), merges equal realized child sets, and applies the finite latent-and-selection projection rules; it is true exactly when the resulting actual projected graph equals \(G\)
